text:
Alex: Heads-up — I pushed a quick snapshot of the new "flightdeck" prompt-cache dashboard. Seeing a ~12% drop in boarding (seed->served) for gptx-3 on /chat-assistant between 03:00–06:00 UTC. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/flightdeck?view=promptcache
Rachel: ugh, noticed latency tail increase too?
Alex: yep, median ok but p99 up ~80ms. Correlates with kernel bump that landed last night (kernel-v2.4).
Jun: can you paste the query you used for token-saved? want to reproduce.
Alex: sure — pulled tokens-saved per-tenant with timeframe and model slice:
```
SELECT tenant_id, model, sum(tokens_saved) as saved, count(1) as hits
FROM prompt_cache.events
WHERE ts BETWEEN '2026-03-11T03:00Z' AND '2026-03-11T06:00Z'
GROUP BY tenant_id, model
ORDER BY saved DESC
LIMIT 200
```
Shyam: quick note — kernel-v2.4 switched some matmul kernels for large batch paths; could affect KV-cache hotkeying because we changed batching heuristics (folding threshold lowered to 12).
Rachel: that folding threshold change was intended to reduce latency on high-concurrency routes, but maybe it caused smaller continuous batches for warmup leading to less key material in cache?
Jun: hypothesis: kernel patch increased per-token compute so our auto-warmup windows (currently 5s sliding) didn't accumulate enough warm requests to populate prefix KVs for mid-size tenants. Could explain hit-rate drop and token-saved losses.
Alex: perf-bot trace attached for a sample tenant: `perf-bot: /traces/4975312345/trace-abc123`
perf-bot: SUMMARY: model=gptx-3 route=/chat-assistant tenant=acme corp hit_rate=0.62 (prev=0.74) token_saved=145k (prev=210k) p99_latency=540ms (prev=460ms)
Shyam: ok - two angles: 1) change batching fold threshold back to 16 or 18 to see if warm batches increase; 2) tweak warmup window to accumulate across slightly longer period (10s) for these routes.
Rachel: also want a dashboard slice per-route + per-tenant so we can detect regressions earlier. The current flightdeck shows per-model and per-route, but not a per-tenant breakpoint for top N tenants. Could we add a top-50 tenant table?
Alex: added a feature request card: /card/FEAT-1282. Quick patch I tried locally: increased folding threshold to 16 and simulated traffic — hit-rate for seeded keys rose from 0.61 -> 0.70 in the sim for gptx-3.
Jun: can we get a reproducible unit test that simulates warmup + batching? I can add a synthetic workload to eng-runtime/testdata that emulates 40–80 reqs/s with typical seq-len distribution.
Shyam: yes, add both: 1) e2e synthetic load test, 2) new telemetry metric: `prefetch_warm_batches_per_window` and `avg_kv_entries_warmed` per model/route.
Alex: logged telemetry request PR: /pr/3689. Also we should gate kernel rollouts by a preflight that compares token-saved delta and hit-rate delta across top-10 tenants. If either regresses >5% we auto-rollback.
Rachel: +1. Can the flightdeck include a small diff panel that shows delta vs baseline for token-saved, hit-rate, p99 latency? would help quick triage.
Jun: I'll wire the diff panel to the existing metrics; need an index on (model, route, tenant) in the metrics db — otherwise queries are slow.
Alex: noted. Ops note: for now I'm reverting folding threshold on the canary pool (canary-2) to 18 and will monitor flightdeck for 30m.
perf-bot: DEPLOY: revert folding-threshold -> 18 on pool canary-2 by Alex @ 2026-03-11T07:10Z
Rachel: thanks. After 30m, if hit-rate climbs back near baseline we can consider reintroducing kernel-v2.4 with batching tweak PR.
Shyam: action items from thread: 
- Jun: add synthetic e2e workload and unit tests (ticket ENG-892).
- Jun: add DB index for (model,route,tenant) metric queries (ENG-893).
- Shyam: add `prefetch_warm_batches_per_window` telemetry + `avg_kv_entries_warmed` (ENG-894).
- Alex: monitor flightdeck and post 30m snapshot to this thread.
Alex: posting 30m snapshot now — flightdeck shows hit_rate for acme corp moved 0.63 -> 0.73 after revert, token_saved recovered ~58k tokens in that window. Link: https://dash.internal/redwood/flightdeck?view=promptcache&slice=canary-2
Rachel: great. closing loop: can we add an automated alert when token-saved drops >10% week-over-week for top 20 tenants? that would've caught this sooner.
Jun: makes sense, will spec alert on ENG-893.
Alex: thanks all. Follow-ups scheduled in the eng-runtime daily sync. :thumbsup:
